event.name: Motion Detected

event.name: Motion Ended
event.description: The motion event on this camera ended.

event.name: Person Detected
event.description: Protect detected a person on this camera.

event.name: Vehicle Detected
event.description: Protect detected a vehicle on this camera.

event.name: Package Detected
event.description: Protect detected a package on this camera.

event.name: Animal Detected
event.description: Protect detected an animal on this camera.

event.name: License Plate Detected
event.description: Protect read a license plate on this camera. The plate text is in the LAST_LICENSE_PLATE variable.

event.name: Face Detected
event.description: Protect detected a face on this camera.

event.description: The doorbell button on this camera was pressed.

property.name: Camera
property.description: Which Protect camera this instance represents. Set by binding this driver's Protect Camera connection to one of the UniFi Protect Gateway's camera connections in the Connections view.

property.name: Gateway Link
property.default: Not bound - bind the Protect Camera connection to the Gateway
property.description: Live view of the conversation with the UniFi Protect Gateway. "Asked... waiting" that never resolves means the Gateway is missing, unbound, or running an old driver version.

property.name: Capabilities
property.description: What this camera reports it can do, from the console's own metadata. Commands the camera lacks the hardware for refuse locally and say so.

property.name: Last Control
property.description: The most recent control command and its outcome.

property.name: Motion Event Cooldown (seconds)
property.description: Minimum seconds between Motion Detected Composer events. Variables always update; only event firing is spaced. 0 disables.

property.name: Detection Event Cooldown (seconds)
property.description: Minimum seconds between Composer events per smart-detection type. 0 disables.

property.name: Snapshots
property.description: Whether snapshot images are available for this camera through the Gateway's snapshot relay.

property.name: Streams
property.description: Which stream qualities the console has provided URLs for.

property.name: Stream Protocol
property.description: How stream URLs are handed to Navigators. RTSP is the default because it is what Control4 clients actually play (measured 2026-08-28 on OS 4.2.1 against Protect 7.2.105: RTSPS rendered black, RTSP played). RTSPS is Protect's native encrypted stream - try it after OS or Protect updates; if it plays, prefer it. The RTSP port is undocumented by Ubiquiti and may disappear in a future Protect version, at which point RTSPS is the only option.

property.name: History
property.description: Writes this camera's detections into Control4's History view (requires the History Agent). Smart detections only records person/vehicle/package/animal/plate/face, doorbell rings, audio alarms and online/offline - everything except plain motion, which fires constantly on a busy camera. All events includes motion.

property.name: Streams Offered
property.description: Which stream qualities are offered to Navigators. Control4 clients pick from the offered list on their own - there is no picker in the app - so limiting the offer is how you choose the resolution. High is the camera's full recording quality; Low keeps multi-camera walls light. If the chosen quality is not available from the console, whatever exists is offered instead of nothing.

property.name: Driver Version
property.description: The build actually running on this instance. If this does not match the newest build after an update, the project is serving a cached copy of the driver.

command.name: Set Doorbell Message
command.description: Show MESSAGE on the doorbell display, optionally reverting after DURATION seconds

command.name: Do Not Disturb
command.description: Set the doorbell display to Do Not Disturb

command.name: Leave Package
command.description: Set the doorbell display to Leave Package At Door

command.name: Reset Doorbell Display
command.description: Reset the doorbell display to its default

command.name: Set LED
command.description: Turn the camera status LED STATE (on/off)

command.name: Set Microphone Volume
command.description: Set the camera microphone volume VOLUME (0-100)

command.name: Run PTZ Preset
command.description: Move a PTZ camera to preset SLOT

command.name: Send Snapshot Notification
command.description: Record MESSAGE in History and fire the Snapshot Notification event (pair it once with a push notification carrying the Camera Snapshot attachment)
